info.title: Qoot Website API
info.description: Public content for www.qoot.com and the endpoints behind the dashboard. Dashboard calls need the session cookie and the X-XSRF-TOKEN header.

put.summary: Saves the working draft. Visitors keep seeing the published version until it is published.

post.summary: Uploads one or more images (multipart field "files"). The type is checked from the file's bytes.
Replaces the file behind a media item; everything using it shows the new picture.

get.summary: Opens a request (and marks it read).
Issues the antiforgery token (and its HttpOnly cookie). Call again after signing in or out.
The whole page for one language: settings, visible sections in order, and search metadata.
Published articles, newest first (articles given a higher priority come first).
One published article. Drafts, scheduled and unknown articles all answer 404.

post.summary: Stores a Contact us message. No authentication; rate limited per address; a hidden field catches bots.
